summary.text: Kelly Kortum is a Democratic state representative from Bozeman who has represented Montana House District 64 since 2021 and is running for Montana State Senate District 32 on November 3, 2026.
He works in information technology and co-founded the Gallatin Progressive Action Network.

paragraphs.text: Kelly Kortum lives in Bozeman, Montana, and earned a bachelor's degree from Montana State University in 2008.
His career experience includes working in information technology, and he co-founded the Gallatin Progressive Action Network.

Kortum has served in the Montana House since 2021, and in the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, House Local Government and House State Administration committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary for State Senate District 32 and faces Republican Neal Ganser in the general election, in a race with no incumbent.
